n2e0dbd8daa.headline: 107 million euro debts become 50: Legislative relief for DEYAH
n2e0dbd8daa.summary: Legislative regulation was submitted to reduce DEYAH Heraklion's loan debts from 107 million euros to 50 million euros, relieving the municipal company of a major financial burden.
n2e0dbd8daa.why: Debt relief for municipal utilities can improve financial sustainability and service delivery in local economies.
